suites.title: I01 session time survives reload, suspension and late return

specs.title: pause → reload → resume: the paused time is kept and the deadline moves by exactly the pause
+5 → reload: the extension, its deadline and the gauge segment survive; completion records the full 30 min once
suspended tab (a real Page Lifecycle freeze) across the end: one completion right after resume, at the real end, "while away" summary
two tabs, the leading one frozen across the end: the other completes it once; the frozen one wakes up and does not add a second
late return: an extended brew that ended 2 h ago while the app was closed completes once, at its real end, with the right minutes
late return to a paused brew: nothing completes; the same time is waiting
repeated finish / tick / end / pause at 0:00 and a double-clicked Tea time: one record, one grant, one break
reload during the whistle and again on the summary: one record, rewards granted once, the summary still there
two tabs on one profile: one record and one grant; both show the same summary; Tea time in one moves both

suites.title: I02 End, dismissal and task disposition

specs.title: dismissing the End sheet (Esc, backdrop, Keep brewing) or leaving the screen never stops the brew
End early after 12 active minutes (with a pause): 12 minutes saved as an unfinished brew, 12 leaves, no full-brew bonus, task kept
End within the first minute: the sheet says nothing will be saved, and nothing is
Done / Carry forward are reversible; the carried task returns on Home; editing it and Mark done → Undo never add a focus record
Skip break, Next brew and That’s all for now do what they say, and never record a skipped break
export → reset (explicit confirmation) → import restores brews, settings and every reward exactly
invalid files change nothing and say why (not JSON, another app, truncated, newer version, huge, empty, damaged)
storage full: a brew that completes still reaches its summary, once; saved data stays intact; a backup carries the brew; making room saves it
storage full: a restore that cannot be saved is refused with a plain reason and changes nothing
“Everything lives on this device”: a brew, an export and an import send nothing anywhere
